indicators.name: Population — Male
indicators.description: Population data from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: New districts use area-proportional estimates.

indicators.name: Population — Female
indicators.description: Population data from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: New districts use area-proportional estimates.

indicators.name: Households
indicators.description: Household data from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: New districts use area-proportional estimates.

indicators.name: Literacy Rate — Total
indicators.description: Literates as a share of the population aged 7 and over, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Denominator is population aged 7+, the Census of India definition. Children under 7 are excluded — dividing by total population instead reads about 10 points low.

indicators.name: Literacy Rate — Male
indicators.description: Literates as a share of the population aged 7 and over, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Denominator is population aged 7+, the Census of India definition. Children under 7 are excluded — dividing by total population instead reads about 10 points low.

indicators.name: Literacy Rate — Female
indicators.description: Literates as a share of the population aged 7 and over, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Denominator is population aged 7+, the Census of India definition. Children under 7 are excluded — dividing by total population instead reads about 10 points low.

indicators.name: Literate Population — Male
indicators.description: Number of literate people from the 2011 Census of India. For the rate, use Literacy Rate.
indicators.caveat: A headcount, not a rate — it tracks district size. Counts ages 7+ only.

indicators.name: Literate Population — Female
indicators.description: Number of literate people from the 2011 Census of India. For the rate, use Literacy Rate.
indicators.caveat: A headcount, not a rate — it tracks district size. Counts ages 7+ only.

indicators.name: Children — Male
indicators.description: Children (0-6 years) data from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: New districts use area-proportional estimates.

indicators.name: Children — Female
indicators.description: Children (0-6 years) data from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: New districts use area-proportional estimates.

indicators.name: Scheduled Castes — Male
indicators.description: Scheduled Caste males as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: SC lists vary by state — not all communities recognized nationwide.

indicators.name: Scheduled Castes — Female
indicators.description: Scheduled Caste females as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: SC lists vary by state — not all communities recognized nationwide.

indicators.name: Scheduled Tribes — Male
indicators.description: Scheduled Tribe males as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: ST lists vary by state — not all communities recognized nationwide.

indicators.name: Scheduled Tribes — Female
indicators.description: Scheduled Tribe females as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: ST lists vary by state — not all communities recognized nationwide.

indicators.name: Worker Participation — Male
indicators.description: Male workers (main or marginal) as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Includes main and marginal workers.

indicators.name: Worker Participation — Female
indicators.description: Female workers (main or marginal) as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Includes main and marginal workers.

indicators.name: Cultivators — Male
indicators.description: Male main cultivators as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Includes both owner-farmers and tenant farmers.

indicators.name: Cultivators — Female
indicators.description: Female main cultivators as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Includes both owner-farmers and tenant farmers.

indicators.name: Agricultural Laborers — Male
indicators.description: Male main agricultural labourers as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Landless wage workers on others' farms.

indicators.name: Agricultural Laborers — Female
indicators.description: Female main agricultural labourers as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Landless wage workers on others' farms.

indicators.name: Other Workers — Male
indicators.description: Male main workers in non-agricultural occupations as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Residual category — industry, services, trade, etc.

indicators.name: Other Workers — Female
indicators.description: Female main workers in non-agricultural occupations as a share of total district population, from the 2011 Census of India.
indicators.caveat: Residual category — industry, services, trade, etc.

indicators.name: Sex Ratio
indicators.description: Females per 1,000 males. National average is ~940. Below 900 indicates severe gender imbalance.
indicators.caveat: National average ~940; below 900 signals severe imbalance.

indicators.name: Child Sex Ratio (0–6)
indicators.description: Girls per 1,000 boys aged 0–6. Below 900 signals sex-selective practices. National average is ~914.
indicators.caveat: Below 900 may indicate sex-selective practices.

indicators.name: Female Literacy Gap
indicators.description: Difference between male and female literacy rates. Higher values mean women are significantly less literate than men.
indicators.caveat: Gap = male literacy rate minus female literacy rate.

indicators.name: Female Work Gap
indicators.description: Difference between male and female worker participation rates. High values indicate women are largely excluded from the workforce.
indicators.caveat: Includes main and marginal workers.

indicators.name: Child Stunting
indicators.description: Children under 5 who are stunted (height for age), from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Height-for-age below −2 SD (WHO Child Growth Standard).

indicators.name: Child Wasting
indicators.description: Children under 5 who are wasted (weight for height), from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Weight-for-height below −2 SD (WHO Child Growth Standard).

indicators.name: Child Underweight
indicators.description: Children under 5 who are underweight (weight for age), from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Weight-for-age below −2 SD (WHO Child Growth Standard).

indicators.name: Child Anaemia
indicators.description: Children age 6-59 months who are anaemic, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Haemoglobin below 11.0 g/dL for children 6–59 months (WHO threshold).

indicators.name: Women Anaemia
indicators.description: All women age 15-49 years who are anaemic, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Haemoglobin below 12.0 g/dL for non-pregnant women 15–49 (WHO threshold).

indicators.name: Full Vaccination
indicators.description: Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (card or recall), from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Includes card-verified and mother's recall. Many districts rest on 25–49 cases (IIPS prints these in brackets); blank where IIPS withheld the value (under 25).

indicators.name: Institutional Births
indicators.description: Institutional births (%), from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Covers births in the 5 years before survey.

indicators.name: Improved Sanitation
indicators.description: Households using improved sanitation facility, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: "Improved" per WHO/JMP classification.

indicators.name: Clean Cooking Fuel
indicators.description: Households using clean fuel for cooking, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: LPG, biogas, or electric — excludes solid fuels.

indicators.name: Health Insurance
indicators.description: Households with health insurance/financing scheme coverage, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Includes government schemes like Ayushman Bharat.

indicators.name: Drinking Water
indicators.description: Households with improved drinking water source, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: "Improved" per WHO/JMP classification.

indicators.name: Electricity Access
indicators.description: Households with electricity, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Measures access, not hours of supply.

indicators.name: Iodized Salt
indicators.description: Households using iodized salt, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Tested with rapid test kit during household visit.

indicators.name: Women Literacy
indicators.description: Women who are literate, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Completed std 9+ or can read a whole/partial sentence.

indicators.name: Women 10+ Yr Schooling
indicators.description: Women with 10 or more years of schooling, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Women age 15–49 with 10+ completed years of schooling.

indicators.name: Child Marriage
indicators.description: Women age 20-24 married before age 18, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Retrospective — women 20–24 who married before age 18.

indicators.name: Teen Pregnancy
indicators.description: Women age 15-19 who were already mothers or pregnant, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Women 15–19 who were mothers or pregnant at time of survey.

indicators.name: Menstrual Hygiene
indicators.description: Women age 15-24 using hygienic menstrual protection, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Women 15–24 using sanitary napkins, tampons, or menstrual cups.

indicators.name: 4+ Antenatal Visits
indicators.description: Mothers who had at least 4 antenatal care visits, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Covers last birth in 5 years before survey.

indicators.name: C-Section Rate
indicators.description: Births delivered by caesarean section (neutral — diverging scale), from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Diverging scale — both very low and very high rates signal issues.

indicators.name: Exclusive Breastfeeding
indicators.description: Children under 6 months exclusively breastfed, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Infants under 6 months exclusively breastfed at time of survey. Many districts rest on 25–49 cases (IIPS prints these in brackets); blank where IIPS withheld the value (under 25).

indicators.name: ORS for Diarrhoea
indicators.description: Children with diarrhoea who received ORS, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Children with diarrhoea in 2 weeks before survey who received ORS. Many districts rest on 25–49 cases (IIPS prints these in brackets); blank where IIPS withheld the value (under 25).

indicators.name: Male Hypertension
indicators.description: Males with elevated blood pressure or on BP medication, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Systolic ≥ 140 or diastolic ≥ 90 mmHg, or on medication.

indicators.name: Male Diabetes
indicators.description: Males with high blood sugar or on diabetes medication, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Random blood glucose > 140 mg/dL, or on medication.

indicators.name: Male Tobacco Use
indicators.description: Men age 15+ who use any kind of tobacco, from NFHS-5 (2019-21).
indicators.caveat: Any form — smoking, chewing, or snuff.

indicators.name: Pending Cases per Lakh
indicators.description: Pending court cases per 1 lakh population, combining NJDG 2024 case data with Census 2011 population
indicators.caveat: District & subordinate courts only. Population from Census 2011.
indicators.estimation_method: Inherited from parent district; Area-proportional estimate (population denominator)

indicators.name: Cases Delayed in Disposal
indicators.description: Share of pending cases that have exceeded prescribed disposal timelines
indicators.caveat: District courts only. "Delayed" = exceeded prescribed disposal timelines.

indicators.name: Chronic Backlog (5+ Yr)
indicators.description: Share of pending cases that have been pending for 5 or more years
indicators.caveat: District courts only. Includes both civil and criminal cases.

indicators.name: Monthly Disposal Ratio
indicators.description: Cases disposed last month divided by cases filed last month. Above 1.0 means the backlog is shrinking
indicators.caveat: District courts only. Single-month snapshot — seasonal variation possible.

indicators.name: Case Density
indicators.description: Pending court cases per square kilometre
indicators.caveat: District courts only. Reflects urbanization as much as caseload.

indicators.name: Women's Court Cases
indicators.description: Share of pending cases filed by women
indicators.caveat: District courts only. Based on petitioner gender where recorded.

indicators.name: Cases at Evidence Stage
indicators.description: Share of pending cases at the evidence, argument, or judgement stage — cases in active hearing
indicators.caveat: District courts only. Combines evidence, argument, and judgement stages.

indicators.name: Climate Vulnerability Index
indicators.description: Composite index of climate vulnerability combining exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity. Higher values indicate greater vulnerability. From DST/ICAR 2021.
indicators.caveat: Composite index — rankings depend on indicator weights. 8 states/UTs excluded (incl. Goa, Delhi).

indicators.name: MGNREGA Days per Household
indicators.description: Average days of employment provided per household under MGNREGA in a year. Higher values indicate greater rural distress and demand for wage labor.
indicators.caveat: Reflects both rural distress and state implementation capacity.

indicators.name: Food Grain Yield Variability
indicators.description: Coefficient of variation in food grain yield. Higher values indicate less stable agricultural output and greater climate vulnerability.
indicators.caveat: Coefficient of variation over historical time series. 8 states/UTs excluded.

indicators.name: Infant Mortality Rate (CVI 2021)
indicators.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births from the Climate Vulnerability Assessment. Different source and year from NFHS health indicators.
indicators.caveat: Different source and year from NFHS-5. 8 states/UTs excluded (incl. Goa, Delhi).

indicators.name: Average Holding Size
indicators.description: Average area of operational agricultural holdings. Larger values indicate less fragmented farming. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Operational holdings (who farms), not ownership. 134 districts inherit parent values.

indicators.name: Marginal Farmers (%)
indicators.description: Share of operational holdings below 1 hectare. Higher values indicate more subsistence-level farming and greater rural vulnerability. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Holdings below 1 Ha. ~68% of India's holdings are marginal (Ag Census 2015-16).

indicators.name: Agricultural Intensity
indicators.description: Percentage of district area under net cultivation. Higher values indicate more intensive agricultural land use. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Net sown area as share of district area. Excludes forests and wastelands.

indicators.name: Fallow Ratio
indicators.description: Ratio of fallow land to net cultivated area. High values indicate underutilized or drought-prone agricultural land. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Includes current fallow and long-term fallow land.

indicators.name: SC/ST Land Equity Gap
indicators.description: Difference between SC/ST share of agricultural land and SC/ST share of population. Negative values mean SC/ST communities hold less land than their population share. From Agricultural Census 2015-16 + Census 2011.
indicators.caveat: Combines Ag Census land data with Census 2011 SC/ST population shares.
indicators.estimation_method: Inherited from parent district; Area-proportional estimate (population denominator)

indicators.name: Holdings per 1,000 People
indicators.description: Number of operational agricultural holdings per 1,000 population. Higher values indicate greater agricultural dependence. From Agricultural Census 2015-16 + Census 2011.
indicators.caveat: Uses Census 2011 population as denominator.
indicators.estimation_method: Inherited from parent district; Area-proportional estimate (population denominator)

indicators.name: Cultivated Land per Capita
indicators.description: Net cultivated area per person. Low values indicate high land pressure or urbanization. From Agricultural Census 2015-16 + Census 2011.
indicators.caveat: Uses Census 2011 population as denominator.
indicators.estimation_method: Inherited from parent district; Area-proportional estimate (population denominator)

indicators.name: Leased Area Share
indicators.description: Share of total operated area that is leased-in. High leasing indicates tenancy insecurity and less incentive for long-term land investment. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Informal tenancy widely underreported — most leases are unregistered oral contracts.

indicators.name: Land Gini Coefficient
indicators.description: Gini coefficient of land distribution across holding size classes. Higher values indicate greater inequality in land ownership. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Calculated from size-class distribution, not individual holdings.

indicators.name: Sowing Efficiency
indicators.description: Ratio of net area sown to net cultivated area. Values near 1.0 mean almost all arable land is actively farmed. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Net sown ÷ net cultivated. Does not capture multi-cropping.

indicators.name: Uncultivated Ratio
indicators.description: Share of total holding area that is uncultivated (waste, built-up, waterlogged). Proxy for land degradation or urbanization within agricultural holdings. From Agricultural Census 2015-16.
indicators.caveat: Includes waste, built-up, and waterlogged land within holdings.

indicators.name: MSME Density
indicators.description: Registered micro, small, and medium enterprises per 1,000 population. Higher density signals a more entrepreneurial local economy. From Udyam Registration 2026.
indicators.caveat: Registered enterprises only — informal sector excluded. Census 2011 population.
indicators.estimation_method: Inherited from parent district; Area-proportional estimate (population denominator)

indicators.name: Total MSMEs
indicators.description: Total number of registered micro, small, and medium enterprises in the district. From Udyam Registration 2026.
indicators.caveat: Registered enterprises only — informal sector excluded.

indicators.name: Manufacturing Share
indicators.description: Percentage of registered MSMEs in the manufacturing sector (vs. services). Higher manufacturing share indicates an industrial economic base. From Udyam Registration 2026.
indicators.caveat: Registered enterprises only. Classified by NIC activity codes.

indicators.name: Small Enterprise Share
indicators.description: Percentage of registered enterprises classified as small (investment ₹1–10 crore). Higher shares indicate more capital-intensive enterprise activity. From Udyam Registration 2026.
indicators.caveat: Registered enterprises only. "Small" = investment ₹1–10 crore.

indicators.name: Bank Credit Per Capita
indicators.description: Occupation-classified outstanding bank credit per person (₹). Higher values indicate deeper financial intermediation. Uses Census 2011 population — urban high-growth districts (Gurugram, Noida, Bengaluru) show inflated values. From RBI BSR-1, March 2026.
indicators.caveat: Reflects where credit was sanctioned, not utilized — financial centres (Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai) show inflated values. Uses Census 2011 population. Covers occupation-classified credit only (subset of total bank credit).
indicators.estimation_method: Inherited from parent district; Area-proportional estimate (population denominator)

indicators.name: Total Bank Credit
indicators.description: Total occupation-classified outstanding credit of scheduled commercial banks in the district (₹ Crores). From RBI BSR-1, March 2026.
indicators.caveat: Reflects where credit was sanctioned, not utilized. Covers occupation-classified credit only (subset of total bank credit). Amounts only — borrower account counts not included.

indicators.name: Agriculture Credit Share
indicators.description: Agriculture sector's share of total outstanding credit (%). High values indicate agrarian lending dependence. From RBI BSR-1, March 2026.
indicators.caveat: Reflects where credit was sanctioned, not utilized. Covers occupation-classified credit only.

indicators.name: Industry Credit Share
indicators.description: Industry sector's share of total outstanding credit (%). Higher values indicate industrial lending concentration — a proxy for the district's manufacturing and mining base. From RBI BSR-1, March 2026.
indicators.caveat: Reflects where credit was sanctioned, not utilized. Covers occupation-classified credit only.

indicators.name: Personal Loans Share
indicators.description: Personal loans (housing, vehicles, education, credit cards) as share of total credit (%). High values indicate a consumer-driven credit market. From RBI BSR-1, March 2026.
indicators.caveat: Reflects where credit was sanctioned, not utilized. Covers occupation-classified credit only.

indicators.name: Trade Credit Share

indicators.name: Monsoon Rainfall vs Normal
indicators.description: How much more or less rain fell in June–September 2026 than the district's normal — its long-term average for the same days. IMD calls −20% or lower deficient, −60% or lower large deficient, and +20% or higher excess.
indicators.caveat: IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.

indicators.name: Monsoon Rainfall

indicators.name: Normal Monsoon Rainfall
indicators.description: The district's normal June–September rainfall in millimetres, as IMD published it for 2026 to the season's last reported day. From the India Meteorological Department.
indicators.caveat: IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.

indicators.name: Annual Rainfall vs Normal
indicators.description: How much more or less rain fell in all of 2025 than the district's normal yearly total. Includes the October–December monsoon, the main rains in Tamil Nadu and coastal Andhra Pradesh.
indicators.caveat: Sum of IMD's four seasons; blank if any season is missing. IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.

indicators.name: Annual Rainfall
indicators.description: Rainfall over the calendar year 2025 in millimetres. From the India Meteorological Department.
indicators.caveat: Sum of IMD's four seasons; blank if any season is missing. IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.

indicators.name: Normal Annual Rainfall
indicators.description: The district's normal calendar-year rainfall in millimetres, as IMD published it for 2025. From the India Meteorological Department.
indicators.caveat: Sum of IMD's four seasons; blank if any season is missing. IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.

indicators.name: Deficient Monsoons
indicators.description: In how many of the six monsoons from 2021 to 2026 the district got at least 20% less rain than normal — IMD's "deficient" level.
indicators.caveat: Blank unless all six years have data. IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.

indicators.name: Excess Monsoons
indicators.description: In how many of the six monsoons from 2021 to 2026 the district got at least 20% more rain than normal — IMD's "excess" level.
indicators.caveat: Season totals, so one extreme-rain day does not count by itself. Blank unless all six years have data. IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.

indicators.name: Average Monsoon vs Normal
indicators.description: The district's average gap from normal across the six monsoons, 2021–2026. Shows places that stay dry or wet year after year, not one bad season.
indicators.caveat: Bageshwar and Tirunelveli read high every year, likely a normal set too low. Blank unless all six years have data. IMD real-time data, not final. Normal is the 1971–2020 average (1961–2010 for 2021). Source gaps and broken rows are left blank; new districts show their parent district's value.
